import sys, json, time, subprocess, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref, gen
K = 64
c = list(range(1, K+1))
rib = []
rng = random.Random(9)
while len(rib) < 625:
    s = rng.randrange(K)
    rot = c[s:] + c[:s]
    rib.append({'path': list(rot), 'count': rng.randint(1, 1000000)})
agg = ref.aggregate([(tuple(r['path']), r['count']) for r in rib], set())
_l, _r, final = ref.peel_naive(agg)
cl = sorted({ref.canon(p[i], p[i+1]) for p in final for i in range(len(p)-1)})
order = gen.find_order(cl, final, random.Random(1), tries=100)
print('core links', len(cl), 'order', 'ok' if order else 'None', 'len sum', sum(len(r['path']) for r in rib))
queries = []
for k in range(512):
    s = k % K
    rot = c[s:] + c[:s]
    queries.append({'id': 'q%d' % k, 'path': rot[:64], 'threshold': [k % 1000001, 1000000]})
doc = {'version': 1, 'ixps': [], 'rib': rib, 'priors': [], 'declared': [],
       'order': order, 'queries': queries}
raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', 'submission/main.py'], input=raw,
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, cwd='/workspace')
print('rc', p.returncode, 'time %.2fs' % (time.time()-t), 'out bytes', len(p.stdout))
r = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('links', len(r['links']), 'core', sum(1 for x in r['links'] if x['round']==0))
print('sample score', r['queries'][0]['score'], 'full', r['queries'][0]['full'])
